evidence.title: Three.js Components, Templates & Interactive Shaders | ThreeUI

name: ThreeUI Community
summary: Open-source Three.js component catalog for React: 3D components, WebGL backgrounds, hero sections, text animations and templates.
description: The login-free Community edition of ThreeUI: 50 parent components across 111 routes, with 141 free variant records and 23 singleton components (164 browse results), plus complete implementation source and required assets. Pieces are copy-ready Three.js components — 3D elements, WebGL backgrounds, buttons, text animation, hero sections and landing-page templates — published as the React package @designcodeio/threeui. Pro components and Pro source stay behind a paid tier.
contains: 50 Community parent components; 111 routes; 164 browse results
catalog categories: sections, 3D assets, buttons, landing pages, text animation, UI elements, backgrounds, hero
Community code MIT; bundled fonts OFL-1.1; bundled Three.js runtime MIT
no login needed for Community; Pro source via CLI with OAuth after purchase
